category: Interconnection Assemblies with Plated Through Holes
source_pdf: MIL-HDBK-217F_NOTICE-2.pdf (Everyspec download of the Notice 2 change pages, 28 February 1995)
model: lambda_p = lambda_b * [N1 * pi_C + N2 * (pi_C + 13)] * pi_Q * pi_E (failures/10^6 hours)

types: Printed Wiring Assembly/Printed Circuit Boards with PTHs
Discrete Wiring with Electroless Deposited PTH (<= 2 Levels of Circuitry)

pi_C.note: P is the number of circuit planes. The first printed row is P <= 2, giving pi_C = 1.0. For discrete wiring with PTH, pi_C = 1.

notes: N1 is the quantity of wave, infrared or vapor phase soldered functional PTHs (automated techniques) and N2 is the quantity of hand soldered PTHs. Because the model is not a plain product of pi factors, the generic part_failure_rate function does not evaluate it; use reliakit::standards217::pth_failure_rate, which implements the printed equation. Page 16-1 supersedes page 16-1 of Revision F. Section 16.2 (surface mount technology, handbook pages 16-2 to 16-4, PDF pages 60 to 62) is a thermal cycling fatigue model and is not included; see the stream notes fragment.
